## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Product Questions
Q: What is FRP grating?
A: FRP (Fiber Reinforced Polymer) grating is a lightweight, corrosion-resistant alternative to steel grating, made from glass fiber reinforced resin. It is used for walkways, platforms, and flooring in corrosive industrial environments.

Q: What is the difference between molded and pultruded FRP grating?
A: Molded grating has bidirectional equal strength and is easier to cut on-site. Pultruded grating has higher unidirectional strength and longer span capability for heavy-load applications.

Q: What thicknesses are available?
A: Standard thicknesses are 25mm, 30mm, 38mm, and 50mm. 25mm for light traffic, 30mm for standard walkways, 38mm for industrial platforms, 50mm for heavy-duty areas.

Q: What resin systems do you offer?
A: We offer orthophthalic polyester (general purpose), isophthalic polyester (wastewater/general chemical), vinyl ester (strong acid/alkali/marine), and phenolic (fire retardant/low smoke).

Q: What surface options are available?
A: Four standard surfaces: concave/meniscus (standard, R9-R10), grit/quartz (maximum slip resistance R13), smooth (polished), and solid cover (waterproof sealed top).

Q: What colors are available?
A: 12 standard colors including gray, yellow, green, blue, red, orange, beige, black, white, brown, tan, and dark gray. Custom RAL color matching available for large orders.

Q: What is the maximum panel size?
A: Standard molded panels: 1220x3660mm (4'x12'). Pultruded panels: up to 6000mm length. Custom sizes available.

Q: Can FRP grating be cut on-site?
A: Yes, FRP grating can be cut with standard tools (circular saw, jigsaw, handsaw). No special equipment needed. Seal cut edges with resin for corrosion protection.

### Pricing & Ordering
Q: What is the price of FRP grating?
A: Prices range from $45-90/m² depending on thickness, resin type, and quantity. Polyester is lowest cost, vinyl ester is 30-50% higher. Contact us for exact quotation.

Q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
A: Our MOQ is 1 piece. We welcome both small and large orders.

Q: What is the lead time?
A: Standard products: 15-20 days. Custom fabrication: 20-25 days. Faster than leading brands (30-45 days).

Q: Do you offer samples?
A: Yes, free samples are available for quality evaluation. Customer pays shipping cost.

Q: Can I get a quotation within 24 hours?
A: Yes, our sales and engineering team provides quotations within 24 working hours.

### Engineering & Technical
Q: Do you provide structural calculations?
A: Yes, our in-house engineering team provides free structural calculations, load/span analysis, and material recommendations.

Q: Do you provide CAD drawings?
A: Yes, we provide CAD drawings (DWG, DXF) for custom fabrication projects.

Q: What fire ratings do you offer?
A: Polyester: Class C (FSI ~100-150). Vinyl ester: Class B-C. Phenolic: Class A (FSI <25) with low smoke and zero halogen. Tested per ASTM E-84.

Q: What is the lifespan of FRP grating?
A: With proper resin selection, FRP grating lasts 20+ years in corrosive environments. ZEALL offers 20+ year warranty.

Q: How does FRP grating compare to steel?
A: FRP is 75% lighter, corrosion-proof, non-conductive, and requires zero maintenance. Over 20 years, FRP saves 40-60% compared to steel (including painting and replacement).

Q: What is the load capacity of FRP grating?
A: 38mm molded grating supports 8.0 kN/m² uniform load at 1200mm span. 50mm heavy-duty supports 12.0 kN/m² at 1500mm span. Pultruded grating supports higher loads and longer spans.

### Installation & Maintenance
Q: How is FRP grating installed?
A: Place panels on support beams, fasten with grating clips (M-clip, C-clip, Z-clip) using stainless steel bolts. Typically 4 clips per panel. No welding required.

Q: What types of clips do you offer?
A: M-clip (standard), C-clip (edge mounting), Z-clip (heavy-duty). Available in SS304 and SS316 stainless steel.

Q: How do I clean FRP grating?
A: Pressure washing with water or mild detergent. Steam cleaning up to 120°C. Avoid abrasive cleaners and solvents.

Q: Does FRP grating need painting?
A: No, FRP grating never needs painting. Color is integrated throughout the material. This is a major advantage over steel.

Q: Can FRP grating be repaired?
A: Minor scratches need no repair. Cracked sections can be cut out and replaced with FRP patch kits.

### Applications
Q: What industries use FRP grating?
A: Wastewater treatment, chemical processing, oil & gas, offshore/marine, power generation, mining, food & beverage, pharmaceutical, pulp & paper, and transportation.

Q: Is FRP grating suitable for offshore platforms?
A: Yes, vinyl ester FRP grating with UV stabilizers and SS316 clips is ideal for offshore platforms. Resistant to saltwater corrosion and UV exposure.

Q: Is FRP grating suitable for wastewater treatment plants?
A: Yes, FRP grating is the standard for wastewater plants due to H2S and chemical resistance. Isophthalic or vinyl ester resin recommended.

Q: Can FRP grating be used in food processing plants?
A: Yes, food-grade resin options are available. Smooth or grit surfaces for wash-down areas.
